sentences.en: The poor old man was reduced to just a skeleton.
sentences.zh: 这个可怜的老头只剩下一副骨架。

sentences.en: In the grave lay a skeleton with a split skull.
sentences.zh: 坟墓里躺着一具裂开头骨的骷髅。

sentences.en: Dr. Skeleton is known for his study on ghosts.
sentences.zh: Skeleton博士因研究鬼魂而出名。

senses.zh: 骨架，骨骼；纲要；骨瘦如柴的人
骨骼的；骨瘦如柴的；概略的
